The substantive text regarding SPRS submission requirements and the evidence-retention rule for § 170.15 is as follows:

**SPRS Submission Fields:**
The Level 1 self-assessment results submitted to the Supplier Performance Risk System (SPRS) must include, at minimum, the following items [L503]:
*   (A) CMMC Level [L505]
*   (B) CMMC Status Date [L507]
*   (C) CMMC Assessment Scope [L509]
*   (D) All industry CAGE code(s) associated with the information system(s) addressed by the CMMC Assessment Scope [L511]
*   (E) Compliance result [L513]

**Evidence-Retention Rule:**
The artifacts used as evidence for the assessment must be retained by the OSA for six (6) years from the CMMC Status Date [L556].
title: eCFR :: 32 CFR 170.15 -- CMMC Level 1 self-assessment and affirmation requirements.
